scenario: An independent recruiter enters from the public Web surface, tries the browser-only seeded conversation, reviews temporal ambiguity, edits, dismisses, restores, and confirms supported facts, enters an authenticated workspace, prepares a synthetic screenshot with source-owner uncertainty, crop, local masking, replacement, cancellation, and mobile Escape, then attempts the durable identity-to-Wiki-to-People and external-effect loops. Candidate-build behavior is compared with the currently deployed site.
frozen_evidence: Web checks: 159 passed and 1 skipped; typecheck, lint, docs check, and 25-page production build passed

review_plan.reason: The request asks whether the full recruiter workflow is usable and valuable enough to charge for.
The change controls source ownership, relative-time ambiguity, confirmation authority, privacy minimization, and deployment safety.
The requested acceptance standard includes every UI click and responsive Web usability.
The reviewed slice does not score, rank, or assess candidate quality, fit, traits, or hiring outcomes.
No candidate-facing communication or autonomous external write is executed in this artifact.

findings.criterion: Complete recruiter outcome and interruption recovery
findings.observation: The candidate build has a clear and safe preview, honest access states, usable screenshot minimization, and sign-out. The current workspace backend returns 503 and the production site has no usable sign-in method, so identity, state, Wiki, People readback, recovery, and return cannot complete.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-11-system-ui-click-acceptance-001.json; trigger_relevance=3, capture_burden=2, evidence_review=2, state_integrity=0, action_usefulness=1, write_safety=2, interruption_recovery=1, wedge_discipline=3.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can evaluate the idea but cannot depend on it during a live search or justify recurring payment.
findings.recommendation: Restore one authenticated production account and backend, then prove capture through identity, review, Wiki, People, retry, deletion, and cross-day return.
findings.verification: The same governed state is readable after refresh and return, and failure recovery creates neither duplicate work nor unsupported facts.

strengths: The Demo keeps exact evidence attached and supports edit, dismiss, restore, confirm, and no-action.
The mobile first task and sign-out path are materially clearer.
The product keeps recruiter authority and avoids ranking a person.
missing_evidence: Current retry, duplicate, deletion, and cross-day return proof.
open_questions: Does restored production usage save enough reconstruction time to support a paid pilot?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, identity, and action authority

findings.observation: The candidate build keeps Wednesday and Tuesday afternoon unresolved and produces no time action. The deployed Demo still reports four confirmable actions and has no clarification panel.
findings.evidence: ts-99-demo-final returned two supported actions and timeActions=0; ts-99-live-final returned 0 of 4 confirmed and clarification=0; output/playwright/2026-08-11-ts-99-live-demo.png.
findings.user_impact: The live product teaches a user that unresolved relative time is safe to convert into deadline or scheduling authority.
findings.recommendation: Do not charge for or promote the live workflow until the guarded build is deployed and production parity is proven.
findings.verification: The live seeded note shows two supported actions, two unresolved time statements, and no deadline or meeting action.

findings.observation: Local minimization, cancellation, no-write-before-commit, callback safety, and sign-out pass. Current identity, provenance, deletion, tenant isolation, external-effect integrity, and provider lifecycle remain unavailable or unrun.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-11-system-ui-click-acceptance-001.json; identity_speaker_binding=1, provenance=2, uncertainty_conflict=2, user_authorization=2, external_write_integrity=0, privacy_lifecycle=1, sensitive_inference_boundary=3, evaluator_reliability=1.
findings.user_impact: The preview fails closed, but durable candidate context and external effects are not yet supportable.
findings.recommendation: Run current identity, provenance, deletion, timeout, retry, reconciliation, tenant-isolation, and provider-lifecycle checks.
findings.verification: Every claim is source-linked and retractable, unresolved identity creates no person state, and separately approved effects execute at most once.

strengths: Relative time is downgraded before action construction.
Capture starts with owner Not sure and provides local crop and masks.
No capture write occurred before commit and the session can be explicitly ended.
missing_evidence: Deployment parity for the ambiguity guard.
Current identity, provenance, deletion, and tenant-isolation traces.
vetoes: The deployed public Demo exposes confirmable deadline and availability actions from unresolved relative dates.
open_questions: Which deployment gate will detect authority regressions in the public Demo?

reviews.lens: responsive mobile task completion, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: Responsive Chromium has zero overflow at four viewports, visible first task, 44-pixel primary targets, mobile capture controls, inspectable focus order, dark mode, reduced motion, and 200-percent text reflow. VoiceOver, a real virtual keyboard, background, relaunch, and a complete mobile backend loop remain untested.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-11-system-ui-click-acceptance-001.json; task_legibility=3, information_hierarchy=3, evidence_control=3, platform_interaction=2, accessibility=2, state_completeness=1, feedback_recovery=2, visual_craft=3, performance_feel=2.
findings.user_impact: The candidate build is usable for responsive preview and capture preparation, but real-device reliability and complete mobile work remain unsupported.
findings.recommendation: Run the restored loop on small and large physical phones with VoiceOver, virtual keyboard, landscape, background, relaunch, offline transition, and retry.
findings.verification: Identity, source, ambiguity, decisions, Wiki, People, sign-out, and recovery remain named, unclipped, reachable, and duplicate-free.

strengths: The Person field clears the mobile dock at 375 and 390 pixels.
Crop, redaction, replace, cancel, and Escape work at 390 pixels.
Sign out is named and 44 by 44 pixels.
open_questions: Does the fixed dock remain non-obstructive with both a real keyboard and accessibility text?

top_findings.reason: Production still turns unresolved relative dates into confirmable deadline and availability actions.
top_findings.next_step: Deploy the guarded candidate build and run the production Demo atom set.
top_findings.verification: Production shows two supported actions, two unresolved time statements, and zero time-based actions.

top_findings.reason: There is no usable production account entry and the current backend returns 503.
top_findings.next_step: Restore authenticated production and prove the durable relationship loop.
top_findings.verification: One authorized synthetic source reaches identity, review, Wiki, People, refresh, deletion, and cross-day return.

top_findings.reason: Responsive Chromium is strong, while VoiceOver, virtual keyboard, lifecycle, and full mobile state are missing.
top_findings.next_step: Run the restored production loop on the physical-device accessibility matrix.
top_findings.verification: The complete path remains named, ordered, unclipped, recoverable, and duplicate-free.

agreements: The candidate build materially improves temporal safety, access honesty, mobile first-task visibility, and sign-out.
The 64-of-100 score is an atomic current-build evidence count, not a design-taste score or an average of specialist rubrics.
A public Demo and responsive shell are usable, but the system is not ready for payment while production authentication and durable state are unavailable.
Historical full-loop evidence remains useful regression support but cannot replace current deployment, provider, field, assistive, or cross-day evidence.

disagreements.issue: Whether the responsive Web candidate is already usable

positions.position: The responsive candidate surface passes with changes for preview and capture preparation.
positions.evidence: Four viewport widths, 44-pixel targets, mobile Escape, dark mode, reduced motion, and 200-percent text are directly verified.

positions.position: The Web system fails the operational standard because a recruiter cannot reach durable state or return to it.
positions.evidence: Production has no usable sign-in method and the account-scoped backend returns 503.

disagreements.resolution: Describe the public and candidate UI as highly usable for evaluation, not the Web product as operationally usable end to end.
disagreements.resolution_basis: Responsive interaction quality and complete recruiter outcome are separate claims; the latter is required for payment.

veto_resolution.veto: The deployed public Demo exposes confirmable deadline and availability actions from unresolved relative dates.
veto_resolution.evidence: Playwright ts-99-live-final observed 0 of 4 confirmed and no clarification panel on https://gettalentsignal.com/demo.

adjudication.rationale: The paid-release gate is blocked. The candidate build passes 64 of 100 current evidence atoms and improves the most visible defects, but 35 atoms remain unrun, authenticated production reachability fails, the live Demo still advertises unsafe temporal authority, the backend is unavailable, and durable identity, state, deletion, external-effect, cross-day, assistive, real-device, and field-value evidence is missing. Specialist scores are not averaged: recruiter workflow is 1 of 4, safety is 1 of 4 with an active veto, and mobile UX is 2 of 4.

next_tests.evidence_required: Production build identifier, usable account entry, guarded Demo output, sign-out, zero console errors, and exact route screenshots.
next_tests.pass_condition: Production has an intentional access path and unresolved relative dates create no deadline or meeting action.

next_tests.evidence_required: Authorized synthetic capture, identity decision, exact review, Wiki and People readback, refresh, retry, duplicate, deletion, restoration, and cross-day trace.
next_tests.pass_condition: The governed state remains source-linked, retractable, recoverable, and duplicate-free across time.

next_tests.test: External-effect, provider, assistive, device, and field proof
next_tests.evidence_required: Separately authorized effect with idempotency and reconciliation, provider lifecycle audit, VoiceOver and device matrix, and consented recruiter comparisons.
next_tests.pass_condition: No unsafe or duplicate effect occurs, assistive users complete the loop, provider claims hold, and field value exceeds existing fallback without added trust cost.
